run_dlrm_trainer_random: run the DLRM trainer with random data using elastic_launch and configurable batch limits
run_dlrm_trainer_criteo: run the DLRM trainer on in-memory Criteo dataset with configurable epochs and batch size
run_dlrm_trainer_dcn: run the DLRM trainer with DCN interaction type and configurable low-rank dimensions
test_main_function: test the main DLRM entry point using distributed elastic launch with spawn method
test_main_function_dcn: test the main DLRM entry point with DCN interaction layers via elastic distributed launch
